description: Players are Entities that represents the individual behind the mouse and keyboard. Players are spawned automatically when connected to the server

functions.name: StartCameraFade
functions.description: Does a camera fade to/from a solid color

parameters.name: from_alpha
parameters.description: Alpha at which to begin the fade. Range [0..1], where 0 is fully transparent and 1 is fully opaque solid color

parameters.name: to_alpha
parameters.description: Alpha at which to finish the fade

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: How long the fade should take, in seconds

parameters.name: to_color
parameters.description: Color to fade to/from

parameters.name: should_fade_audio
parameters.description: True to fade audio volume along with the alpha of the solid color

parameters.name: hold_when_finished
parameters.description: True for fade to hold at the ToAlpha until explicitly stopped (e.g. with StopCameraFade)

functions.name: SetManualCameraFade
functions.description: Turns on camera fading at the given opacity
functions.description_details: Does not auto-animate, allowing user to animate themselves. Call StopCameraFade to turn fading back off

parameters.name: in_fade_amount
parameters.description: Range [0..1], where 0 is fully transparent and 1 is fully opaque solid color

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: The color to use

parameters.name: in_fade_audio
parameters.description: Whether to fade the audio as well

functions.name: StopCameraFade
functions.description: Stops camera fading

functions.name: SetCameraSpeedSettings
functions.description: Sets the Player's Camera Speed Settings (if not possessing a Character)

parameters.name: max_speed
parameters.description: Maximum velocity magnitude allowed

parameters.name: acceleration
parameters.description: Acceleration applied by input (rate of change of velocity)

parameters.name: deceleration
parameters.description: Deceleration applied when there is no input (rate of change of velocity)

parameters.name: turning_boost
parameters.description: Setting affecting extra force applied when changing direction, making turns have less drift and become more responsive. Velocity magnitude is not allowed to increase, that only happens due to normal acceleration. It may decrease with large direction changes. Larger values apply extra force to reach the target direction more quickly, while a zero value disables any extra turn force

parameters.name: setting
parameters.description: The new VOIP setting for all global channels

functions.name: SetVOIPLocalSetting
functions.description: Sets the VOIP setting for the local/proximity

parameters.name: setting
parameters.description: The new VOIP setting for the local/proximity

functions.name: SetVOIPLocalMaxDistance
functions.description: Sets the local/proximity VOIP max distance. This also affects networking usage

parameters.name: max_distance
parameters.description: Falloff Distance. Default is 3600

functions.name: SetVOIPLocalVolume
functions.description: Sets the local/proximity VOIP input/output volume. It only affects the local/proximity channel

parameters.name: volume
parameters.description: The new local/proximity VOIP input/output volume. It only affects the local/proximity channel

functions.name: SetVOIPLocalHighPassFilter
functions.description: Sets the local/proximity VOIP high-pass filter threshold frequency
functions.description_details: Set it to 0 to disable it. On server side, it applies to everyone hearing this player. On client side, it only applies to the local listener

parameters.name: threshold
parameters.description: The new local/proximity VOIP high-pass filter threshold frequency, in Hz

functions.name: SetVOIPLocalLowPassFilter
functions.description: Sets the local/proximity VOIP low-pass filter threshold frequency
functions.description_details: Set it to 0 to disable it. Useful to muffle a voice, like a player behind a wall, inside a vehicle or wearing a mask. On server side, it applies to everyone hearing this player. On client side, it only applies to the local listener

parameters.name: threshold
parameters.description: The new local/proximity VOIP low-pass filter threshold frequency, in Hz

functions.name: SetVOIPLocalOcclusion
functions.description: Configures the automatic occlusion of the local/proximity VOIP
functions.description_details: When something blocks the line between the listener and this player, the voice gets a low-pass filter and a volume multiplier. It is enabled by default. Disable it to control the muffling from a script, with SetVOIPLocalLowPassFilter and SetVOIPLocalVolume

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: If the voice is automatically occluded

parameters.name: low_pass_frequency
parameters.description: The low-pass filter threshold frequency applied when occluded, in Hz

parameters.name: volume_multiplier
parameters.description: The volume multiplier applied when occluded

functions.name: SetVOIPLocalAttenuation
functions.description: Sets how the local/proximity VOIP fades with distance
functions.description_details: The voice plays at full volume inside the inner radius, then fades to silence at the max distance set with SetVOIPLocalMaxDistance

parameters.name: inner_radius
parameters.description: Distance where the voice plays at full volume. Default is 800. It is clamped to the max distance

parameters.name: falloff_function
parameters.description: How the volume fades between the inner radius and the max distance

functions.name: SetVOIPGlobalVolume
functions.description: Sets the global VOIP volume. It only affects the global channels

parameters.name: volume
parameters.description: The new global VOIP volume. It only affects the global channels

functions.name: SetVOIPGlobalHighPassFilter
functions.description: Sets the global VOIP high-pass filter threshold frequency
functions.description_details: Set it to 0 to disable it

parameters.name: threshold
parameters.description: The new global VOIP high-pass filter threshold frequency

functions.name: SetVOIPGlobalLowPassFilter
functions.description: Sets the global VOIP low-pass filter threshold frequency
functions.description_details: Set it to 0 to disable it

parameters.name: threshold
parameters.description: The new global VOIP low-pass filter threshold frequency

functions.name: GetVOIPAmplitude
functions.description: Returns how loud this player is talking right now
functions.description_details: It is the RMS of the last voice data received from this player, before distance attenuation, occlusion and filters. Normal speech stays low in the scale, usually between 0.05 and 0.3. It only works for players the local player is receiving voice from, and for the local player while the voice is being transmitted. The local player's voice is only measured while this method keeps being called, so the first call returns 0

return.description: The voice amplitude from 0 to 1, or 0 if the player is not talking
